intro: The Comoros is a volcanic island nation between Mozambique and Madagascar, known as the 'Perfume Islands'.

chapters.title: Sultanates
text: Swahili, Arab, Malagasy and African settlers shaped the islands. Rival sultans ruled each island, trading across the Indian Ocean.

chapters.title: French rule
text: France took the islands in the 1800s. In 1975 three islands voted for independence, while Mayotte voted to stay French, a dispute that continues.

chapters.title: Coups and change
text: The Comoros has had around 20 coups or attempts since independence. A 2001 constitution rotated the presidency between the islands.

timeline.title: Secession crisis
timeline.text: Two islands try to break away.

keyTerms.meaning: An island claimed by the Comoros but governed by France.
